manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down, pulling down even at the top.
manifest.description: A ball is tossed upward along a height scale. A blue vector indicates its velocity, shortening as it rises and pointing downward as it falls, while a dashed gravity vector remains constant.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
